title: Achievements - House of Pips Wiki
description: The House of Pips achievements you can see from the start, the checklists behind them, and how progress is kept.
html:
Achievements

House of Pips has 21 achievements. The ones below are visible from the start; the rest are hidden until you earn them, and this wiki doesn't list them. The gallery groups tutorials, match milestones, collections, modes, puzzles, career and Rank Up, then hidden achievements. The Rank Up badges stay together in rank order, and hidden badges keep their group after you earn them.

Scroll the gallery to see every badge. A hidden badge and its mode-checklist label become visible only after you earn that specific achievement.

Nana Knows Best
Complete Nana's tutorial.
Know Your Rival
Complete every Rival tutorial lesson.
Seat at the Table
Win your first match.
Across the Table
Finish a public or private online match.
Well Supplied
Use every consumable at least once.
Every Trick in the Book
Put every perk to use.
Hard Knocks
Experience the effect of every malus.
Open House
Unlock every perk.
A Table for Every Taste
Win a match in every game mode.
House Rules
Unlock Custom matches.
Puzzle Master
Complete all 20 puzzle levels.
Top of the Track
Reach career level 30 for the first time.
Another Round
Rank up for the first time.
Third Time's the Charm
Reach Rank 3 in single player.
Four of a Kind
Reach Rank 4 in single player.
House Legend
Reach Rank 5 in single player.

Plus 5 hidden achievements. This wiki does not list them; finding them is part of the fun.

Career ranks #

Another Round marks your first rank up, which reaches Rank 2. The next three milestones are Third Time's the Charm at Rank 3, Four of a Kind at Rank 4 and House Legend at Rank 5. These require two, three and four completed rank ups respectively.

These are career ranks earned through Rank Up, separate from your online rank. See Career, XP and Bone Bucks for the rank rewards and resets. Earlier reached ranks count when you launch. Opening or canceling Rank Up earns nothing; completing it earns the badge once the new rank is saved.

Checklists #

Several achievements track a checklist. Open an achievement's Details to see which entries you still need:

  • Well Supplied use each supply at least once. Buying it doesn't count.
  • Every Trick in the Book put every positive perk to use in a match.
  • Hard Knocks experience the effect of every malus.
  • Open House unlock every perk in the Perks compendium.
  • A Table for Every Taste win a match in every game mode. Some modes stay hidden on the checklist until you reach them.

Progress and Steam #

  • Achievement progress is a lifetime record: it carries across rank ups.
  • With Steam running, earned achievements also unlock on Steam, and the gallery shows how many players have earned each one.
  • Clean Slate clears local achievement progress, but achievements already unlocked on Steam stay there.
